summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.09/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.09 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 4, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 17¢ lower than a week ago, 35¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.37 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.89) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.29).
